This pertains to the visual and audio arts, to the writings, and to the code itself.

If you would like a similar website, then start with:

1.  Writing the outline for the articles you want
2.  Writing the content for those articles
3.  Putting the images together you want for your site
4.  Then drawing or having AI generate a rough draft image of what your site would look like

If you have all of those, then [hit me up](http://localhost:8000/#?/contact). I've taught multiple students vibe coding and can walk you through the same.

### The Bias (+ The $20)

As of December 2009, the FTC mandates that influencers disclose any hidden interests or unspoken biases when making recommendations. Let me save us both some time: every single piece of content on this site is dripping with bias. I've collaborated with over 5,000 artists, musicians, influencers, and celebrities over my lifetime. You should safely assume that every word and reference here involves money changing hands, heavy bias, a sex scandal behind at least half of it, and Jimmy -- goddammit, Jimmy! -- you STILL fucking owe me that $20!

### The Hustle

Make no mistake, this blog has financial motivations. Official links to my media and merch are plastered everywhere. I'll even be dropping a donation link, because I am absolutely not above digital panhandling. This site exists to promote the people, places, and things that I love -- including the rides and random souls I meet out on the road, all of whom the FTC would demand I formally disclose.

**Bottom Line**: when someone spits the phrase "capitalist bastard," I want it to be my hairy white a$$ flashing through your imagination (pun intended). _Got that, fleshie?_

### The Politics

Politically, I lean toward what Heinlein called "a rational anarchist" (anti-corporatist, anti-communist, anti-fascist). I am aggressively engaged in causes that champion individual rights and absolute freedom of expression: whistleblowers, smokers' rights, pro-choice activism, gay rights, gun rights, hacktivism, pro-AI. The list goes on. I founded Burn as One dot Org, as well as the sister-syndicate #The-Art-of-Smoking over on deviantART. _Penny for the Guy?_ #anon

I've also run with the P5Y (Peace in 5 Years) crew in the past. While I'm generally opposed to the tyrannical pipe dream of world peace, I make exceptions for the rare few who can actually wire the heart and mind together in that pursuit.

### The Credit

A massive shoutout to Tim Ferriss for the inspiration behind some of this disclosure wording, taking an otherwise soul-crushing legal requirement and injecting it with actual humor. Rules is rules. To paint a picture of how deep the rabbit hole goes: I've bought Tim's books, my friend Eben was plotting the launch of Tim's very first book just a week before it dropped, and you'll find the good mister "socks and sandals" himself hopping in and out of my circles. Don't even get me started on Burning Man.

_You really don't know the half of it._
